label: airFiber 4X
description: 4.9 GHz licensed-band airFiber X backhaul radio for public safety (4.7-4.9 GHz in some regions), antenna sold separately. Up to 687 Mbps real throughput, 200+ km range, AES-128, 24 V passive PoE in. Ports: 1x GbE data RJ45 + 1x 10/100 MbE management RJ45, plus RP-SMA RF and GPS antenna connectors.
